svg.title: How the endpoint container calls inference.py
svg.desc: The serving app in the container answers GET /ping and POST /invocations on port 8080. At startup it calls model_fn once with /opt/ml/model to load the model. For each request it calls input_fn to parse the request body, predict_fn to run the model, and output_fn to build the response body.
